neighbours.label: the function word right after a named person or body, where a new phrase begins (a man named Maury Ginsberg to..., Araye of Benilloba on..., Pius VI by..., MLA now...), as opposed to the same phrase after a common noun
fire: She gave a lift to a man named Cyrus Bellamy to the station.
Yusuf Karim wounded Hassan Omar of Tarifa on account of a debt.
Scholars tried to connect the verse to Clement V by citing a letter.
Marta shouted to a couple of the Blue team, and they ran over.
We are cooperating with NATO now to draft the plan.
The prize went to Lena Hoffmann for a study of bees.
He sold the farm to Abel Dunmore in order to pay the bank.
Critics compared the novel to Tolstoy on the grounds of length.
quiet: She gave a lift to an old man to the station.
A soldier wounded a farmer in the village on account of a debt.
Scholars tried to connect the verse to an old prayer by citing a letter.
Marta shouted to a couple of the kids, and they ran over.
We are cooperating with the neighbors now to draft the plan.
The prize went to a young student for a study of bees.
He sold the farm to a cousin in order to pay the bank.
Critics compared the novel to a long poem on the grounds of length.

notes: A probe with no name ('a friend to the festival') reached 0.27, so a name may not be needed: an odd second 'to' could be enough. Chinese '有' after a name reached 0.85.
